Hellfire Watchers are a type of Steel Watcher found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Baldur's Gate.

Overview

Hellfire Watchers are similar to Steel Watchers except for having a few additional attacks. As many as five of them can be encountered in the game; two of them appear on the lab level to monitor the Gondians, while three guard the control centre alongside the  Steel Watcher Titan.

Combat

Each Hellfire Watcher wields a  Watcher Greatsword. Those who guard the Titan Watcher are armed with  Watcher Crossbows as well. Neither weapon drops when the Hellfire Watcher dies.

Immunities

Hellfire Watchers are immune to:

  •  Bleeding
  •  Burning
  •  Charmed conditions, such as  Charmed and  Dominated
  •  Drunk
  •  Exhausted
  •  Frightened conditions, such as  Frightened and  Phantasmal Killer
  •  Melting
  •  Poisoned conditions, such as  Poisoned and  Nauseous
  •  Polymorphed
  •  Roiling Hellfire
  •  Surprised
  •  Unconscious conditions, such as  Sleeping and  Prone
  • TTactician Effects that cause ⁠Lightning vulnerability[2]

  • Enriched Infernal Iron
